news.title: Smaller, Faster, Just as Accurate
news.description: Presented a poster at the IIN conference on a compact deep learning model that detects and identifies E. coli and Salmonella after 2 hours of incubation, 22× faster than a SAM-based model.

news.title: M.S. Thesis Defended
news.description: Defended my thesis on deep learning for early detection and identification of E. coli and Salmonella Typhimurium in time-stamped microscopy images.

news.title: Accepted: Journal of Food Protection
news.description: Rapid Detection of Salmonella Typhimurium Microcolonies Using Phase-Contrast Imaging and Deep Learning was accepted for publication.

news.title: Accepted: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
news.description: Edits in the Wild: A Multilingual Benchmark for Localizing On-Device Generative Image Edits on Consumer Platforms was accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference.

news.title: SIUC Spotlight 🎉
news.description: Featured in SIUC Graduate Student Spotlight for my research on deep learning-based bacteria detection to improve food safety.

news.title: Workshop
news.description: Had the opportunity to present our research to students of Agricultural Sciences at SIUC
